passages.note: Nguyen voted Y on HB2492 (2022) at House Third Reading, which passed 31-26-3-0-0.
Nguyen is listed as a co-sponsor of HB2492 (2022), which the Governor signed as Chapter 99.

passages.provision_quote: any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: The enacted bill text requires registration applicants to supply satisfactory evidence of citizenship, matching rung 5's documentary-proof clause.

rows.reasoning: Nguyen co-sponsored and voted Y on HB2492 (2022), a single-subject Arizona bill titled "voter registration; verification; citizenship" that was signed into law; its operative text requires registration applications to be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship or be rejected, matching the rung text "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote."
